svg.title: Tech arsenal - Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C, C#, Java, Dart, PHP; Web & API: React, Next.js, Vue, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Django, Flutter, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Vite, Jest, HTML5, CSS3, REST API, Keycloak; AI / ML: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, OpenCV, YOLO, Hugging Face, spaCy, pandas, Jupyter, Google Colab, Vertex AI, LM Studio, BERT, NLTK, Matplotlib; Gen AI & Agents: Anthropic API, OpenAI API, Claude Code, LangChain, Ollama, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini; Data, Cloud & DevOps: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Oracle, MS SQL Server, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Heroku, Vercel, Nginx, Ubuntu, Git; Offensive Security: Kali Linux, Parrot OS, Burp Suite, Metasploit, OWASP ZAP, Wireshark, Hashcat, Hack The Box, TryHackMe, Nmap, SQLmap, Hydra, BloodHound, John the Ripper, Gobuster, Aircrack-ng; Defence & Forensics: Snort, pfSense, Packet Tracer, Ghidra, IDA, Volatility, Autopsy, FTK Imager; Tooling: GitHub, VS Code, Bash, Postman, Jira, Figma, IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio
